items.name: glass-provider
items.title: Glass Provider
items.description: Sets the theme and accessibility preferences that every Glassy UI component follows.

items.name: glass-surface
items.title: Glass Surface
items.description: The glass material as a plain div, for building your own glass components.

items.name: glass-button
items.title: Glass Button
items.description: A glass button with four variants, three sizes and an asChild mode for links.

items.name: glass-panel
items.title: Glass Panel
items.description: A glass container in a panel, card or pill shape.

items.name: glass-header
items.title: Glass Header
items.description: A floating glass header with a brand, navigation links, actions and a compact menu.

items.name: glass-input
items.title: Glass Input
items.description: A recessed glass text field with an optional label and hint.

items.name: glass-checkbox
items.title: Glass Checkbox
items.description: A glass checkbox with an optional label, description and indeterminate state.

items.name: glass-radio-group
items.title: Glass Radio Group
items.description: A group of glass radio buttons where exactly one option is chosen.

items.name: glass-textarea
items.title: Glass Textarea
items.description: A recessed glass text area that can grow with its text.

items.name: glass-select
items.title: Glass Select
items.description: A select field whose options open on a raised glass panel.

items.name: glass-tabs
items.title: Glass Tabs
items.description: Tabs on a glass pill, with one indicator that moves to the selected tab.

items.name: glass-dialog
items.title: Glass Dialog
items.description: A modal glass dialog with an overlay, a focus trap and a close button.

items.name: glass-popover
items.title: Glass Popover
items.description: A glass popover anchored to the control that opens it.

items.name: glass-tooltip
items.title: Glass Tooltip
items.description: A small glass label that appears on hover and keyboard focus.

items.name: glass-toast
items.title: Glass Toast
items.description: A glass notification for brief updates that screen readers announce.

items.name: glass-accordion
items.title: Glass Accordion
items.description: Collapsible glass sections that open one at a time or several at once.

items.name: glass-switch
items.title: Glass Switch
items.description: A glass on/off switch in two sizes.

items.name: glass-slider
items.title: Glass Slider
items.description: A glass slider for one value or a range, with one named thumb per value.

items.name: glass-segmented-control
items.title: Glass Segmented Control
items.description: A single-choice glass control for two to six options, with a draggable selection.

items.name: glass-badge
items.title: Glass Badge
items.description: A small tinted glass label for status, counts and categories.

items.name: glass-progress
items.title: Glass Progress
items.description: A glass progress bar for known values, with a sweeping state for unknown lengths.

items.name: glass-spinner
items.title: Glass Spinner
items.description: A small spinning ring that tells screen readers something is loading.

items.name: glass-skeleton
items.title: Glass Skeleton
items.description: A glass placeholder block, circle or set of text lines shown while content loads.

items.name: glass-alert
items.title: Glass Alert
items.description: A tinted glass message with four tones, an icon and an optional dismiss button.

items.name: glass-avatar
items.title: Glass Avatar
items.description: A round photo that falls back to initials, with a presence dot and stacked groups.

items.name: glass-kbd
items.title: Glass Kbd
items.description: A keycap for showing keyboard shortcuts in menus, hints and docs.

items.name: glass-scroll-area
items.title: Glass Scroll Area
items.description: A scroll container with a thin glass scrollbar that shows on hover and while scrolling.

items.name: glass-dock
items.title: Glass Dock
items.description: A row of app icons on a glass shelf, with labels on hover and focus.

items.name: glass-breadcrumb
items.title: Glass Breadcrumb
items.description: A breadcrumb trail to the current page, with an ellipsis for folded steps.

items.name: glass-pagination
items.title: Glass Pagination
items.description: Numbered page buttons with previous and next, folding long runs into an ellipsis.

items.name: glass-sheet
items.title: Glass Sheet
items.description: A modal glass panel that slides in from a screen edge; bottom sheets drag down to close.

items.name: glass-menu
items.title: Glass Menu
items.description: A glass dropdown menu with shortcuts, checkbox and radio items, and submenus.

items.name: glass-command
items.title: Glass Command
items.description: A searchable command list that filters as you type, alone or in a dialog.

items.name: glass-lens
items.title: Glass Lens
items.description: A draggable magnifier with a glass rim that bends the content beneath it.

items.name: glass-scene
items.title: Glass Scene
items.description: A WebGL2 canvas that refracts a backdrop image through the glass components inside it.

items.name: glass-logo-reveal
items.title: Glass Logo Reveal
items.description: A WebGL2 logo sting: a ball of thick glass swells around your mark, squares into a glass tile and clears, leaving the real mark.

items.name: glass-laptop
items.title: Glass Laptop
items.description: A CSS 3D laptop mockup whose screen shows your screenshot or React content.

items.name: glass-phone-duo
items.title: Glass Phone Duo
items.description: A WebGL2 folding phone mockup with your screenshots on both displays.

items.name: glassy-theme

items.name: glassy-ui-new-york
items.title: Glassy UI components for shadcn/ui (new-york)
items.description: Replaces shadcn/ui's new-york components (Radix (radix-ui)) with Glassy UI versions that keep their API, so your imports stay as they are.

light.glassy-gloss: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.02), transparent 65%), linear-gradient(rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08), transparent 45%)

[data-slot='alert']:is([data-variant='de.box-shadow: var(--glassy-raised), inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--glassy-src-destructive) 40%, transparent)

[data-slot='alert']:is([data-variant='de.background-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--glassy-src-destructive) 14%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--glassy-src-background) 88%, transparent))

[data-slot='badge'].background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--glassy-chip) 14%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--glassy-src-background) 88%, transparent))
[data-slot='badge'].box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5), inset 0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--glassy-chip) 40%, transparent)

:is([data-slot='input'], [data-slot='tex.transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease

[data-slot='kbd'].box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5), inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(var(--glassy-edge) / var(--glassy-edge-alpha)), 0 1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.16)

[data-slot='button']:not([data-variant='.background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 43%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.01), transparent 70%), linear-gradient(rgb(255 255 255 / 0.35), transparent 60%)
